title: Boot UI: a real Quit option when setup fails
description: Someone stuck on a genuine setup failure (offline, GitHub unreachable, no fallback Sikarugir Creator install) previously had only 'Check Again' - no on-screen way out at all, only the undiscoverable Cmd+Q. Adds a plain, deliberately understated 'Quit Playdock' link under the real retry button.
commit_message: Add a Quit button to the setup-failure screen
